contracts_changed: Application.run_with_context accepts explicit progress/confirmation policy; application no longer owns terminal input or TTY detection. Presentation gathers missing fields, and assembly confirmation occurs after candidate validation.
Added the ExecutionProgress port so application code reports worker start events while Presentation owns terminal output.
implemented: Kept app::Application as a compatibility re-export over the application module.
Moved environment/doctor dispatch to application/environment.rs.
Moved project defaults, init and assembly use cases to application/config.rs.
Moved variant commands to application/edit.rs and component lifecycle commands to application/extensions.rs.
Moved run dispatch and run-record helpers to application/run.rs.

Removed UserInteraction and all prompt/readiness calls from application and ports. Application now returns structured missing-input errors; ApplicationUiServices clones the command, gathers missing interactive inputs and passes the explicit command onward.
Moved TTY checks and progress display policy into presentation; removed terminal detection and prompt methods from application ports.
Preserved assembly safety: validate candidate first, ask for confirmation in presentation, revalidate and commit only on yes; no leaves project config unchanged.
Moved Model inspect/probe/verify job construction to application/model.rs and Layer command/atomic-plan construction to application/edit.rs.
Moved Try/Train job construction, repeat/resume source resolution and training input validation into application/train.rs; diagnostics flow back as Result<Job, Report>.
Moved run list/show/attach/stop/clean use cases to application/run_query.rs and training export to application/artifacts.rs.
Split ports into backend, project_config, edit, runs, artifacts and components contracts while preserving crate::ports re-exports.
Added a serializable recording/replay Backend test; a doctor request/report round-trips through a transcript without a Python backend or terminal dependency.
新增 application/data.rs，统一批次入口、参数与 binding 的应用层解析，并将无效参数转换为结构化诊断。
将监督身份检查/活动运行选择归入 application/run_query.rs，将训练试跑 repeat 与训练 resume 记录解析归入 application/train.rs；运行状态规则与对应查询/训练用例同域维护。
将编辑成功后的源码补丁校验、事务提交与失败回滚、变体持久化及响应整理封装为 application/edit.rs 的编辑用例处理；source edit lock 生命周期仍由共享执行路径覆盖整个 backend 调用与提交。
新增 application/run_lifecycle.rs，负责运行记录脱敏输入与持久化、训练文件路径预配、监督进程身份登记、后台 worker 启动和最终报告保存；detached 条件缺少 run id 时返回结构化诊断而不是 panic。
新增 application/run_inputs.rs，承接项目配置默认值合并、变体编辑时恢复项目接缝和正式训练输入检查；错误仍返回既有结构化诊断。
模型参数解析、注入组件解析及锁内组件清单校验归入 application/model.rs；源码编辑目标冲突、模型前置条件、undo/redo 与注册 Provider 解析归入 application/edit.rs。run.rs 保留高层编排。
新增 PreparedRunInputs 与 application/run_prepare.rs，统一准备模型/批次/变体输入；变体和源码编辑锁由准备结果持有，覆盖 Backend 调用和编辑结果提交，维持事务原有锁范围。
新增 domain::WorkerRequest 作为 Python worker protocol v1 的显式字段契约，并由 application/run_request.rs 做 run_name 校验和序列化；Backend 仍接收兼容 Value，生命周期路径字段在运行记录创建后注入。
Removed the last application-layer eprintln; Presentation now handles human progress through the ExecutionProgress port, while JSON mode installs no terminal observer.
Added scripts/check_architecture.py and a human/JSON differential test that compares reports and backend requests through the actual run_command/ApplicationUiServices bridge.
